items.q: All we'd do was open up his set, you know, and play a few songs for him

ctx.x: All we'd do was open up his set, you know, and play a few songs for him, you know, and get the people coming in, you know. Meeting them, spare a few hymns and let them come on in singing the hymns. That's all we did --
